integrity: The older pair classification and pair counting literature is acknowledged, with novelty assessed only for higher tuple lengths and their geometric/arithmetic consequences. No independent external validation is represented.
scientific_limitations: Only reduced varieties of two-dimensional representations are classified; no claim about nonreduced representation schemes, higher matrix sizes, or conjugacy-orbit classification. General formulas are proved directly; finite tests are supplementary. Historical priority remains provisional.
title: Pairwise-annihilating two-dimensional representations: components and finite-field census
